purpose: Validate completed review then seal all owned files with SHA256 manifest
argv: from pathlib import Path; import json; r=Path('.'); names=['review.md','review.json','mandatory-addenda.json','classification-decisions.json','final-validation.json']; assert all((r/n).is_file() for n in names); [json.loads((r/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for n in names if n.endswith('.json')]; print('Final review files present and JSON parseable; product tests=0; formal_increment=0')
seal_algorithm: After native validation capture and diagnostic append, enumerate every regular owned file except FINAL-manifest.json, record relative path/raw SHA256/bytes, write new FINAL-manifest.json exactly once; no later file writes.
